Hi Elena — thanks for the note and the usage report. Sorry to hear about the blocker. Two practical paths we usually take:

- Short extension (2–3 weeks) with a conditional credit: Redwood provides the extension and Wellspire commits to a small non-refundable deposit or a defined success milestone that flows into committed spend if you convert.
- One-off top-up: you buy an incremental token pack, no calendar change; useful if engineering can finish inside the upgraded bucket.

Given you prefer an extension and finance wants something on the books, my suggestion is: we will approve a 3-week extension if Wellspire agrees to a $7.5k credit reservation that converts to a 3-month committed credit if you sign a conversion LOI within 45 days of pilot end. If not, the reservation is applied against final pilot overage.

I looped in Jordan to flag any operational constraints. Ill follow up with legal/finance language if you like this approach.

Best,
Marcus
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
